modules.Dashboard: Provides a high-level visual overview of health metrics, trends, and real-time statistics.
modules.Budget: Used for managing financial allocations, tracking budget utilization across different departments.
modules.Export: Enables users to extract data into reports, filter records, and print document summaries.
modules.Voucher: Handles the management of financial vouchers, including check numbers and disbursement tracking.
modules.Itemized: Allows for detailed tracking of specific items, transactions, and individual expense records.
modules.Monthly Expenses: Provides a monthly breakdown of all costs and expenditures within the office.
modules.Special Fund: A module focused on monitoring and managing unique or localized health project funds.
